lines.text:
I can’t ever forgive Team Rocket!\c
Right now we’re taking care of a Cubone whose
mother, Marowak, was...\c
She was caught by Team Rocket, and that was it.\c
We never saw her again...

The ghost of the Pokémon Tower is gone!
Someone must have soothed its restless spirit!\c
And a Trainer adopted that young Cubone.
I’m so glad everything worked out in the end.
